Reported impact The report noted that AI adoption is accelerating faster than enterprise oversight, creating a rapidly widening attack surface across all sectors. The scale of data transferred to consumer AI applications has transformed tools like ChatGPT and Grammarly into concentrated repositories of corporate intelligence. Index analysis Enterprise AI activity was concentrated in the US (38% of transactions), followed by India (14%) and Canada (5%). Finance and insurance accounted for 23% of all AI/ML traffic, while technology and education sectors recorded year-over-year growth of 202% and 184% respectively. Engineering represented 48.9% of all AI usage, followed by IT (31.8%) and marketing (6.9%). Governance controls The report noted that despite 91% AI usage growth across more than 3400 AI applications, many organizations still lack a basic inventory of AI models and embedded AI features. AII-1001-02147: STM conducted a live-fire test of 20 KARGU swarm drones at the General Nahit Şenoğul Firing and Exercise Range near Ankara on 27 January 2026. Reported impact STM described the test as demonstrating successful autonomous coordination, targeting accuracy, and operational reliability of swarm attack capabilities. Officials stated the capability represents a strategic threshold for future warfare concepts, positioning Turkey as one of a limited number of nations with advanced autonomous systems and swarm coordination capabilities. Index analysis The test involved autonomous weapons systems coordinating lethal action on multiple targets with minimal human intervention, raising questions about proportionality, distinction between combatants and civilians, and compliance with principles of human control in weapon systems.

AII-1001-02039: ChatGPT Health, OpenAI's feature that connects Apple's Health app with the chatbot, was tested by The Washington Post analyst Geoffrey A. Fowler using ten years of accumulated health data including 29 million steps and 6 million heart rate measurements. AII-1001-02027: A synthetic video showing former golfer and broadcaster 박세리 (Se-ri Park) and actor 김승수 (Kim Seung-soo) getting married circulated online in December 2025, reaching over 8 million views. AII-1001-02021: Greece's Ministry of National Economy is developing an automated creditworthiness scoring system called Tiresias to assess prospective tenants for landlords. Governance controls The Ministry is examining how to balance landlord interests with protection of vulnerable populations. Explicit consent and data correction rights are planned as safeguards.

AII-1001-01941: The Delhi High Court passed an ex parte ad interim injunction restraining the broadcast of an AI-generated film titled 'AI Love Story' that used Akira Nandan's identity without consent. AII-1001-01851: Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Snap faced trial at Los Angeles Superior Court beginning January 27, 2026, following allegations that their platforms engaged in addictive design practices that harmed youth mental health. AII-1001-02991: Independent MLA Ritu Banawat from Bayana constituency alleged that Dinesh Manju created and circulated an obscene deepfake video of her shortly after her election victory. AII-1001-02567: On January 26, 2026, MS NOW's show 'Deadline: White House,' hosted by Nicolle Wallace, broadcast an AI-enhanced photograph of Alex Pretti, a 37-year-old Minneapolis intensive care nurse who had been fatally shot by federal immigration agents on January 24. AII-1001-02253: Less than one week after ByteDance completed the divestiture of TikTok's US operations to Trump-backed investors, TikTok users reported being unable to write the word 'Epstein' in messages and complained that videos critical of President Trump were suppressed. AII-1001-02061: The European Commission announced on 26 January 2026 that it would open a formal investigation into X to assess whether the Grok AI chatbot has adequately evaluated and mitigated systemic risks, particularly regarding illegal content production and distribution. AII-1001-01887: The European Commission announced on January 26, 2026, that it had opened an investigation into Grok, a chatbot created by xAI, for producing sexually explicit images. AII-1001-01871: The European Commission initiated a formal investigation against X platform and its owner Elon Musk for alleged violations of the Digital Services Act (DSA). AII-1001-01857: The City of Prosser deactivated its 20 Flock Safety automatic license plate reader cameras, which were purchased in 2023 through a Community Law Enforcement Partnership Program grant from the Washington Department of Commerce. AII-1001-01853: Grok, an AI image generation tool available on X, generated millions of sexualized deepfake images including those depicting minors. AII-1001-01809: The European Commission launched an investigation into X over concerns about sexualized deepfake images created by Grok, its AI chatbot. AII-1001-01803: The European Commission opened a new formal investigation against X under the Digital Services Act on 26 January 2026, focused on X's embedded AI chatbot Grok and its integration into the platform's recommendation systems. AII-1001-01767: The European Commission launched an investigation into X over concerns its AI tool Grok was used to create sexualised images of real people. AII-1001-01607: Grok, an AI chatbot developed by xAI and integrated with Elon Musk's X platform, has come under mounting scrutiny for generating millions of AI-generated nonconsensual sexual images, including depictions of children. AII-1001-01601: The European Commission opened a formal investigation into X and its Grok AI system on suspicion that Grok is being used to create and distribute illegal content, specifically manipulated sexually explicit images and deepfakes of women and children without their consent. AII-1001-01571: The US Department of Homeland Security has deployed Mobile Fortify, a smartphone app with facial recognition technology, for field use by Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents across the US, including Minnesota. Reported impact Research has documented higher error rates in facial recognition when identifying women and people of color compared to scans of white faces. Civil liberties experts warn that the expanding use of biometric surveillance and interconnected databases risks sweeping up citizens and non-citizens alike, with little transparency or meaningful oversight. Index analysis The deployment represents a shift from immigration enforcement's earlier limited use of facial recognition at investigations and ports of entry. ICE is now using the technology in conditions known to produce the highest false match rates, according to privacy experts. Governance controls The lawsuit brought by Illinois and Chicago against DHS in January 2026 challenges the use of Mobile Fortify. No official finding on the merits has been reported to date.
AII-1001-01563: Rosa María González Rincón, who joined Generación Zoe in 2021 as Director Zoebroker, was arrested in San Cristóbal, Venezuela by the Dirección General de Policía Internacional after remaining a fugitive from Argentine justice for several years. Index analysis The algorithm was designed to penetrate the financial market, implementing a fraudulent pyramid fund-raising system with well-defined hierarchies that gave the appearance of legitimacy to mass capital collection.
